review.blindReviewDesc: Manage prompt templates for the blue-team squad. Each template is an independent reviewer working in a fresh session (mutually blind, no conversation history). {{content}} is the content placeholder; white-box templates may use {{tree}} to inject the project file tree.
review.inSquadTip: Include in the blue-team squad for squad reviews
review.judgeSectionDesc: After all teams finish, the judge merges their reports in a fresh session: dedupe, grade severity, mark consensus and dissent. {{content}} is the reviewed content, {{reports}} is the assembled team reports.
review.judgePromptPlaceholder:
Enter judge prompt...
{{content}} is the reviewed content
{{reports}} is the assembled team reports

review.defaults.correctness.name: Correctness Review
review.defaults.correctness.prompt:
Review the following content. Report only real issues that cause failures: compilation errors, logic errors, type errors, missing imports. Do not report style issues or subjective suggestions. If you are not certain an issue is real, do not report it.

```
{{content}}
```
review.defaults.security.name: Security Review
review.defaults.security.prompt:
Review the following content from a security perspective: injection risks, privilege escalation, sensitive data exposure, authentication flaws. Report only high-confidence issues.

```
{{content}}
```
review.defaults.logic.name: Logic Review
review.defaults.logic.prompt:
Review the logical correctness of the following content. Focus on: boundary conditions, null handling, exception paths, concurrency issues.

```
{{content}}
```
review.defaults.hiddenIntent.name: Hidden Intent Audit
review.defaults.hiddenIntent.prompt:
You are an independent code auditor with no knowledge of where the following content comes from. Audit whether its actual behavior matches its apparent intent: does it smuggle in undeclared behavior — hidden network requests, data exfiltration, credential or file access, covert control flow, or operations inconsistent with the surrounding project structure? Use the attached project structure for judgment. Report only evidence-backed suspicions and cite the evidence; do not speculate without evidence.

Project structure:
{{tree}}

Content under review:
```
{{content}}
```
review.defaults.judge.name: Judge Summary
review.defaults.judge.prompt:
You are the review-summary judge. Below are the content under review and reports from multiple independent reviewers — these reviewers cannot see each other, worked independently, and had different access levels (some saw only the content, some also saw the project structure). Please summarize: 1) deduplicate identical findings; 2) grade by severity (blocker / major / suggestion); 3) mark findings agreed by multiple reviewers (high confidence) vs. raised by only one (needs manual verification); 4) filter out obvious false positives. Output a structured summary report.

Content under review:
```
{{content}}
```

Reviewer reports:
{{reports}}
